Creatures: Artificer and artifact creatures: Thopters, massive energy producers and token engines.
Instants: Counterspells and draw that generate energy along the way.

plan_html:
⚡ ENERGY CHOSEN PLAN

The dominant plan for Saheeli, Radiant Creator (1,209 Energy decks, 745 Artifacts, 288 Tokens on EDHREC).

  • How it plays: every Artificer or artifact spell you cast gives you an energy counter. You stockpile energy passively, then spend it on massive outlets (Aetherworks Marvel, Roil Cartographer, Architect of the Untamed). Saheeli is the engine: the artifacts you cast to feed the plan also give you the 3 to make your hasty 5/5 copy each combat.
  • Core mechanic: the energy economy — Decoction Module, Gonti's Aether Heart and Era of Innovation turn every creature or artifact entering into , while Izzet Generatorium (+1 on each gain) and Aether Refinery (doubling) explode production. Nissa, Worldsoul Speaker turns 8 into free permanent spells.
  • Win conditions: infinite combats — Lightning Runner (8 = an extra combat phase) copied or backed by Aetherwind Basker; infinite turns — Gonti's Aether Heart recurred by Academy Ruins and copied as a 5/5; or Aetherflux Conduit (50 = 7 cards + free spells) as the finisher.
source_html: “Building Modern Boros Energy In Commander” (Kara Blinebry, EDHREC Articles, March 19, 2026 — a guide to converting a Modern deck into EDH): the guide validates the plan through its insight on the energy economy — “nearly every card in Boros Energy is a must-kill threat by itself”. Transposed to Saheeli: every engine piece (Decoction Module, Gonti’s Aether Heart, Era of Innovation) is a must-kill — protect them, and energy production snowballs into infinite combats and turns.
